Maps a logical id to a sibling checkout the harness drives. `working_dir` is relative to the harness root. `verify` is documentation only — nothing runs it automatically; it tells the agent what command YOU run by hand, so it can name it in impl_<id>.md as the verification path.

repos.name: <repo name>
verify: <the command you run by hand, e.g. ./mvnw test>
repos.notes: <what it does, and whether it talks to PERSONETICS>

repos.notes: Manifests, ConfigMaps, HPAs, network policies. Agents validate; humans apply.
